text:
Maria: Starting deploy DH-451 now. Canary 15% for 5m -> 50% for 5m -> 100% if green. Smoke plan below; pinging @Jon @Sam for watch. :rocket:

Jon: on it. watching latency, errors, and allocator OOMs. Which dashboard? https://dash.redwood/prod/dh-451

Maria: Smoke steps: 1) `/smoke run --suite basic-quick` (3 prompts) 2) `/bench embed --model dh-451 --batch 8 --duration 30s` 3) check token-latency p50/p95/p99 and reqs/sec 4) verify no 5xx > 1% and no new infra alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary started — target 15% traffic. canary_id=c-19b

Maria: kicking off smoke commands:
```
/smoke run --suite basic-quick --model dh-451
```

deploy-bot: smoke: 3/3 passes, mean token latency 135ms, no 5xx

Lee: seeing a small p95 uptick (190 -> 230). p99 OK. Keeping canary.

Sam: agreed. if p99 exceeds 350ms or 5xx > 1% we stop and roll back. also watching prefix-cache hits.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 50% traffic. canary_id=c-19b -> 50%

Maria: running embed bench at 50%:
```
/bench embed --model dh-451 --batch 8 --duration 30s
```

deploy-bot: embed bench: 320 req/s, 99th latency 110ms

Oliver: infra looks stable. rollback ready: ops runbook DH-451 -> revert-to v2026-05-17. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/dh-451 --to-revision=42`

Jon: no anomalies on metrics or infra. small redis-miss blip resolved. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 100% traffic. canary_id=c-19b -> complete

Maria: shifting stable traffic and capturing post-deploy evals. Keeping 20m heightened watch window. Logs archived to s3://redwood-prod/logs/dh-451/2210456789

Sam: marking post-deploy smoke as PASS. will alert if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:

Maria: closing thread — no rollback performed, tests green.
